get_character.description: Get one Final Fantasy character by ID or by name, typed any way, with everything moogleAPI holds: a description, their role, affiliation, race, hometown and abilities, their art, their game and their popularity. A name is found through the service's search, within a game when one is given; a name several characters share fails naming them, and a name nobody has fails too.

description: Look up Final Fantasy's characters, monsters and games through moogleAPI, a free, open fan project: eighteen games from the first Final Fantasy to Final Fantasy XVI with X-2 and XIII-2, over 2,000 characters with their role, affiliation, race, hometown, abilities, art and popularity, and over 3,800 monsters with where they are fought, their HP, level and battle stats, weaknesses, abilities, drops and steals, bosses marked. List a game's cast or bestiary, get a character or monster by ID or by name, search names and descriptions, pick a character at random for a character of the day, and read each game's release, platform and logo. No API key needed; one lifts the rate limit tenfold.
